verses.en: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
verses.pt: Não podia já José se conter diante de todos os que estavam ao seu lado, e clamou: Fazei sair de minha presença a todos. E não ficou ninguém com ele, ao dar-se a conhecer José a seus irmãos.
verses.en_web: Then Joseph couldn’t control himself before all those who stood before him, and he cried, “Cause everyone to go out from me!” No one else stood with him, while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.
verses.en_bbe: Then Joseph, unable to keep back his feelings before those who were with him, gave orders for everyone to be sent away, and no one was present when he made clear to his brothers who he was.

verses.en: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.
verses.pt: Então se deu a chorar por voz em grito; e ouviram os egípcios, e ouviu também a casa de Faraó.
verses.en_web: He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.
verses.en_bbe: And so loud was his weeping, that it came to the ears of the Egyptians and all Pharaoh's house.

verses.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.
verses.pt: E disse José a seus irmãos: Eu sou José: vive ainda meu pai? E seus irmãos não puderam lhe responder, porque estavam perturbados diante dele.
verses.en_web: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Does my father still live?” His brothers couldn’t answer him; for they were terrified at his presence.
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph said to his brothers, I am Joseph: is my father still living? But his brothers were not able to give him an answer for they were troubled before him.

verses.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.
verses.pt: Então disse José a seus irmãos: Achegai-vos agora a mim. E eles se achegaram. E ele disse: Eu sou José vosso irmão o que vendestes para o Egito.
verses.en_web: Joseph said to his brothers, “Come near to me, please.” They came near. “He said, I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: Then Joseph said to his brothers, Come near to me. And they came near, And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom you sent into Egypt.

verses.en: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, não vos entristeçais, nem vos pese de haver me vendido aqui; que para preservação de vida me enviou Deus diante de vós:
verses.en_web: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.
verses.en_bbe: Now do not be troubled or angry with yourselves for sending me away, because God sent me before you to be the saviour of your lives.

verses.en: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.
verses.pt: Que já houve dois anos de fome em meio da terra, e ainda restam cinco anos em que nem haverá arada nem colheita.
verses.en_web: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be no plowing and no harvest.
verses.en_bbe: For these two years have been years of need, and there are still five more years to come in which there will be no ploughing or cutting of grain.

verses.en: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
verses.pt: E Deus me enviou adiante de vós, para que vós restásseis na terra, e para vos dar vida por meio de grande salvamento.
verses.en_web: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.
verses.en_bbe: God sent me before you to keep you and yours living on earth so that you might become a great nation.

verses.en: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.pt: Assim, pois, não me enviastes vós aqui, mas sim Deus, que me pôs por pai de Faraó, e por senhor de toda sua casa, e por governador de toda a terra do Egito.
verses.en_web: So now it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: So now it was not you who sent me here, but God: and he has made me as a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.

verses.en: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:
verses.pt: Apressai-vos, ide a meu pai e dizei-lhe: Assim diz teu filho José: Deus me pôs por senhor de todo Egito; vem a mim, não te detenhas:
verses.en_web: Hurry, and go up to my father, and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says, “God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me. Don’t wait.
verses.en_bbe: Now go quickly to my father, and say to him, Your son Joseph says, God has made me ruler over all the land of Egypt: come down to me straight away:

verses.en: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children’s children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:
verses.pt: E habitarás na terra de Gósen, e estarás perto de mim, tu e teus filhos, e os filhos de teus filhos, teus gados e tuas vacas, e tudo o que tens.
verses.en_web: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be near to me, you, your children, your children’s children, your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.
verses.en_bbe: The land of Goshen will be your living-place, and you will be near me; you and your children and your children's children, and your flocks and herds and all you have:

verses.en: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.
verses.pt: E ali te alimentarei, pois ainda restam cinco anos de fome, para que não pereças de pobreza tu e tua casa, e tudo o que tens:
verses.en_web: There I will nourish you; for there are yet five years of famine; lest you come to poverty, you, and your household, and all that you have.”’
verses.en_bbe: And there I will take care of you, so that you and your family may not be in need, for there are still five bad years to come.

verses.en: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
verses.pt: E eis que, vossos olhos veem, e os olhos de meu irmão Benjamim, que meu boca vos fala.
verses.en_web: Behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.
verses.en_bbe: Now truly, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin see, that it is my mouth which says these things to you.

verses.en: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.
verses.pt: Fareis pois saber a meu pai toda minha glória no Egito, e tudo o que vistes: e apressai-vos, e trazei a meu pai aqui.
verses.en_web: You shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. You shall hurry and bring my father down here.”
verses.en_bbe: Give my father word of all my glory in Egypt and of all you have seen; and come back quickly with my father.

verses.en: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
verses.pt: E lançou-se sobre o pescoço de Benjamim seu irmão, e chorou; e também Benjamim chorou sobre seu pescoço.
verses.en_web: He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.
verses.en_bbe: Then, weeping, he took Benjamin in his arms, and Benjamin himself was weeping on Joseph's neck.

verses.en: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
verses.pt: E beijou a todos os seus irmãos, e chorou sobre eles: e depois seus irmãos falaram com ele.
verses.en_web: He kissed all his brothers, and wept on them. After that his brothers talked with him.
verses.en_bbe: Then he gave a kiss to all his brothers, weeping over them; and after that his brothers had no fear of talking to him.

verses.en: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, Joseph’s brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
verses.pt: E ouviu-se a notícia na casa de Faraó, dizendo: Os irmãos de José vieram. E pareceu bem aos olhos de Faraó e de seus servos.
verses.en_web: The report of it was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, “Joseph’s brothers have come.” It pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
verses.en_bbe: And news of these things went through Pharaoh's house, and it was said that Joseph's brothers were come; and it seemed good to Pharaoh and his servants.

verses.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
verses.pt: E disse Faraó a José: Dize a teus irmãos: Fazei isto: carregai vossos animais, e ide, voltai à terra de Canaã;
verses.en_web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this. Load your animals, and go, travel to the land of Canaan.
verses.en_bbe: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Say to your brothers, Put your goods on your beasts and go back to the land of Canaan;

verses.en: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.
verses.pt: E tomai a vosso pai e vossas famílias, e vinde a mim, que eu vos darei o bom da terra do Egito e comereis a gordura da terra.
verses.en_web: Take your father and your households, and come to me, and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.’
verses.en_bbe: And get your father and your families and come back to me: and I will give you all the good things of Egypt, and the fat of the land will be your food.

verses.en: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
verses.pt: E tu manda: Fazei isto: tomai para vós da terra do Egito carros para vossos filhos e vossas mulheres; e tomai a vosso pai, e vinde.
verses.en_web: Now you are commanded: do this. Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
verses.en_bbe: And say to them, This you are to do: take carts from the land of Egypt for your little ones and for your wives, and get your father and come back.

verses.en: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.
verses.pt: E não se vos dê nada de vossos pertences, porque o bem da terra do Egito será vosso.
verses.en_web: Also, don’t concern yourselves about your belongings, for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.”
verses.en_bbe: And take no thought for your goods, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.

verses.en: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
verses.pt: E fizeram-no assim os filhos de Israel: e deu-lhes José carros conforme a ordem de Faraó, e deu alimentos para o caminho.
verses.en_web: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel did as he said; and Joseph gave them carts as had been ordered by Pharaoh, and food for their journey.

verses.en: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.
verses.pt: A cada um de todos eles deu mudas de roupas, e a Benjamim deu trezentas peças de prata, e cinco mudas de roupas.
verses.en_web: He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.
verses.en_bbe: To every one of them he gave three changes of clothing; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred bits of silver and five changes of clothing.

verses.en: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.
verses.pt: E a seu pai enviou isto: dez asnos carregados do melhor do Egito, e dez asnas carregadas de trigo, e pão e comida, para seu pai no caminho.
verses.en_web: He sent the following to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.
verses.en_bbe: And to his father he sent ten asses with good things from Egypt on their backs, and ten she-asses with grain and bread and food for his father on the journey.

verses.en: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.
verses.pt: E despediu a seus irmãos, e foram-se. E ele lhes disse: Não brigais pelo caminho.
verses.en_web: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”
verses.en_bbe: And he sent his brothers on their way, and said to them, See that you have no argument on the road.

verses.en: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,
verses.pt: E subiram do Egito, e chegaram à terra de Canaã a Jacó seu pai.
verses.en_web: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.
verses.en_bbe: So they went up from Egypt and came to the land of Canaan, to their father Jacob.

verses.en: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob’s heart fainted, for he believed them not.
verses.pt: E deram-lhe as novas, dizendo: José vive ainda; e ele é senhor toda a terra do Egito. E seu coração se desmaiou; pois não cria neles.
verses.en_web: They told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt.” His heart fainted, for he didn’t believe them.
verses.en_bbe: And they said to him, Joseph is living, and is ruler over all the land of Egypt. And at this word Jacob was quite overcome, for he had no faith in it.

verses.en: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:
verses.pt: E eles lhe contaram todas as palavras de José, que ele lhes havia falado; e vendo ele os carros que José enviava para levá-lo, o espírito de Jacó seu pai reviveu.
verses.en_web: They told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. When he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob, their father, revived.
verses.en_bbe: And they gave him an account of everything Joseph had said to them; and when he saw the carts which Joseph had sent for them, his spirit came back to him:

verses.en: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
verses.pt: Então disse Israel: Basta; José meu filho vive ainda: irei, e lhe verei antes que eu morra.
verses.en_web: Israel said, “It is enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”
verses.en_bbe: And Israel said, It is enough: Joseph my son is still living; I will go and see him before my death.
